title: Not All Matches Are Equally Valuable: An Online Experiment of Retention-Focused Recommendation in a Job-Matching Platform
abstract: arXiv:2609.01652v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recommender systems in two-sided matching platforms are commonly optimized for immediate engagement signals such as click-through rate, reply rate, or the total number of successful matches. However, in real-world marketplaces, maximizing matches alone may be misaligned with business goals such as user churn rate and platform revenue, especially when users with fewer matches are at substantially higher risk of churn. In this paper, we study a real job matching platform and show that users with very few recent matches are indeed much more likely to leave the platform, while additional matches for already successful users provide limited marginal value for retention. Motivated by this empirical finding, we formulate a retention-aware recommendation problem and implement a simple post-processing method that adjusts the baseline match-focused ranking to prevent user churn. translated_title: 并非所有匹配都具有同等价值：求职匹配平台中以留存为导向的推荐在线实验
translated_abstract: 双边匹配平台中的推荐系统通常以即时参与信号进行优化，例如点击率、回复率或成功匹配的总数。然而，在现实世界的市场中，仅最大化匹配数量可能与用户流失率和平台收入等业务目标不一致，尤其是当匹配较少的用户面临明显更高的流失风险时。在本文中，我们研究了一个真实的求职匹配平台，结果表明近期匹配很少的用户确实更有可能离开平台，而对于已经很成功的用户来说，额外的匹配对留存的边际价值有限。基于这一实证发现，我们提出了一个以留存为导向的推荐问题，并实现了一种简单的后处理方法，通过调整以匹配为中心的基线排序来防止用户流失。具体而言，该方法对有流失风险的
tldr: 本文通过真实求职匹配平台的在线实验发现，匹配很少的用户流失风险显著更高，而成功用户的额外匹配边际留存价值有限，并据此提出一种留存感知的后处理方法，通过提升有流失风险用户的匹配排序得分来预防用户流失。
en_tdlr: An online experiment on a real job-matching platform reveals that users with few matches face substantially higher churn risk while extra matches yield limited retention value for successful users, motivating a retention-aware post-processing method that boosts rankings for churn-risk users to prevent churn.
